thread:
Maya R.: Quick preflight for the attestation/orchestration work tied to the base-image rebuild next week. Need sign-off on RBAC deltas, audit logging shape, and KMS rotation plan. Proposed maintenance window: Tue 03/30 02:00-03:00 UTC. Thoughts?
Samir: 1h might be tight if we need canary + sign-off. +1 to doing all prep in advance. Who's owning the cosign/key ceremony?
Priya: I can own cosign signing. A couple of clarification Qs: 1) Are we using ephemeral per-build keys or environment-scoped long-lived keys? 2) Where do attestation logs land (s3 vs internal audit cluster)? 3) Do we need explicit IAM for the pipeline to read key metadata?
Alex C.: For RBAC I propose adding a new role `attest.signer` in keystore project with these perms: kms.cryptoSign, storage.objects.get (for SBOM blobs), and logging.logEntries.create. Bind to group `image-signers@redwood.com`. Pipeline SA gets limited impersonation scoped to `projects/keystore/serviceAccounts/cosign-signer@...`.
Maya R.: @security-bot can you confirm audit retention policy and whether KMS key IDs are recorded in plaintext in logs? Also any PII concerns for the attestation payloads?
security-bot: sys.audit: retention=365d by default for attestation logs. Logs include KMS key id and key version fingerprint; we currently do not redact key ids. Attestation payloads include image digest and attest metadata — no customer PII expected. See internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/attest-orch-logging
Samir: OK re: retention. For Dedicated tenants we must ensure their certs/keys don't leak into hosted logs. Can we ensure tenant scoping in log labels?
Priya: Yes — we'll add `tenant_id` label to every attestation log and filter in ingestion. For hosted->dedicated separation we'll write a policy: no tenant_id exported to central hosted S3.
Jordan (ops): HSM capacity check — staging OK, prod needs procurement. Remote key ceremony is possible but needs 2 operators and a live audit stream (we can do Zoom + audit recording). Need owners for key custody and recovery steps.
Maya R.: Good notes. Let's capture the canary plan: 1) Build new base image -> sign with staging cosign key (ephemeral key per-build) 2) Canary deploy to infra-canary cluster, verify attestation logs and RBAC events 3) Promote key or rotate to prod HSM-backed signing for production image 4) Cutover images for runtime pools.
Priya: I advocate ephemeral per-build signing for staging, but HSM-backed, auditable signing for prod. We'll script key provisioning:
```bash
# provision ephemeral cosign key (staging)
cosign generate-key-pair -k /tmp/staging-key
cosign sign --key /tmp/staging-key my-registry/redwood/base:v2026-03-30
```
Also will add `--annotations tenant_id=${TENANT}` to signatures.
Alex C.: On RBAC change rollout: propose feature-flagged addition of `attest.signer` role and a canary binding applied to `image-signers-canary` group first. After 24h pass, roll to `image-signers` org group. Update terraform module: `modules/iam/attest_roles.tf` and create migration PR.
Samir: Who handles migration PR + test plan? I can take the PR but need Priya to supply key provisioning test harness and Jordan to confirm HSM availability windows.
Jordan (ops): I'll open a procurement ticket for HSM prod slots and set aside a 2h window for remote ceremony. ETA procurement ~7 business days. For the canary we can use container-signer VM with transient keys.
Maya R.: Action items summary: 
- Priya: deliver key-provisioning scripts + cosign annotations (due: Fri)
- Alex C.: PR for terraform changes + canary binding (due: Mon)
- Jordan: HSM procurement ticket + schedule ceremony (due: EOD Thu)
- Samir: owner for migration PR review and test plan (assigned)
- security-bot / SecEng: confirm log export filters to prevent tenant leakage (follow-up)
Samir: Also: please add audit alert for any `kms.cryptoSign` calls outside the ceremony window — set temp alert to P2.
security-bot: ack — creating alert rule `attest_unexpected_signs_v1`.
Priya: One more question — should we rotate cosign keys post-cutover or keep prod key long-lived and rotate on schedule? Ops/security recommendations?
Alex C.: Prefer scheduled rotation (90d) with automated key rollover using staged new-key signing + verifier update. Avoid manual revoke unless compromise.
Maya R.: OK we'll document rotation cadence and automated rollover. Final check: can everyone make the brief sync Wed 10:00 UTC to confirm readiness?
Samir: I can.
Priya: Yes.
Jordan (ops): I'll be there and bring the procurement ticket.
Maya R.: Thanks all — will post the runbook link and PRs in the thread as they appear. :thumbsup:
